_comment: Curated cuisine-family assignment. Families are grounded in TF-IDF ingredient-similarity clustering (within-family mean cosine 0.626 vs cross-family 0.354) with documented domain overrides where data and culinary history disagree.

_overrides.american_south: Dendrogram places southern_us inside the anglo cluster (british 0.758, irish 0.731 — an 'anglo baking' signature) and cajun_creole nearest southern_us 0.541 / spanish 0.516, with french only 4th at 0.458. Domain override groups the two US-South cuisines together.
_overrides.western_european: french is a bridge cuisine — nearly tied between british 0.692 and italian 0.669 — so it gets its own family rather than forcing it into anglo or mediterranean.
_overrides.anglo_northern_european: russian embeds inside the anglo cluster in the data (british 0.684, irish 0.670), not a separate eastern bloc.
_overrides.caribbean: jamaican's top data neighbor is filipino (0.508, shared vinegar/pork/thyme/scallion profile), but it stays its own family on domain grounds.
